# Coop Presence Status

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/coop-presence-status`

Real consumers: **1** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The compact, non-interactive app chrome that reports connected room participants from an explicit view-model count.

> **Guidance:** Supply visibility from app chrome state rather than hiding the status with injected presentation rules.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number \| null` | yes | — | Presence-derived connected client count, or null while it resolves. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | yes | — | Explicit chrome state supplied by the app-shell view model. |

## Usage

```tsx
import { CoopPresenceStatus } from "src/cumulus/components/hud/CoopPresenceStatus";

<CoopPresenceStatus count={connectedCount} visible={showConnectedCount} />
```
